notes.title: Multiplayer Server Update - With more regions!
notes.notes:
Hello Humans,

We have updated our multiplayer servers! While we hope that this will make them more stable, we have had to make a lot of changes to make them work on the new service, so we need your help to make sure they work properly!

But first, the best news... MORE SERVER REGIONS!

We have added [b]US West[/b],[b] EU East [/b]and [b]Asia East[/b] servers! These locations give players in those areas servers that are closer to them. Unfortunately we had to remove the Singapore server region but the Asia East server region will cover those people that used it and hopefully mean the matches have more people in them!

The full list of available regions is now:
[list]
[*]Asia East
[*]Australia
[*]Brazil
[*]EU East
[*]EU West
[*]Japan
[*]US East
[*]US West
[/list]
[h2]Help us check the servers work for you![/h2]

We have tested these new servers as much as we can but multiplayer issues can be really specific to your local internet connection. We would love to know if the online performance of the game is better or worse for you.

If you encounter any of the below, please submit a bug report:
[list]
[*]Does matchmaking not work for you?
[*]Does your game get laggy when your ping is still low?
[*]Does your co-op match crash after a long time?
[/list]

You can send us a bug report via email bugs@doborog.com or on our Discord in the #cddz-bug-reports chat. As always with bug reports, if you can send us a video of your problem, that makes it a lot easier for us to understand how to fix it!

We plan on continuing to improve the servers and matchmaking over time, so any feedback is super helpful. Thanks to all who have helped us make the game better with your bug reports and feedback so far!

- Josh, Doborog Community Manager

notes.title: Multiplayer Hotfix - 1.0.0.29
notes.notes:
We just pushed a fix for multiplayer not connecting which began occurring about 18 hours ago. Let us know if you are still unable to connect to multiplayer for any reason, making sure to [url=https://support.doborog.com/l/en/clone-drone/game-version-check-update]confirm your game version is updated to 1.0.0.29[/url].

[h2]What needed fixing?[/h2]

Around 10pm EST Tuesday we noticed a majority of player connections began failing. After investigating we learned from our multiplayer networking service provider that a service they relied on went down and would require a client-side patch to hotfix their library. So we had to update the game client to fix it!

[h2]What about consoles?[/h2]

We are submitting the same fix to Switch and PS4 shortly and asking for emergency patch review, but it may depend on how long their reviews take, fingers crossed!

Xbox should be uninterrupted, let us know if you do see any issues connecting to games. Cross-play should also still be intact!

[h2]Why did resolving it take the whole day?[/h2]

We were waiting for our partner to completely fix the problem with a patch fix, which just came in 45 mins ago - so we got it implemented, re-tested and pushed it live just now!

Thanks to everyone who let us know about this issue early, and for everyone’s patience while we got this sorted out!

notes.title: Hotfix: Minor Performance Optimization!
notes.notes:

Let us know if you notice anything different!

Cheers,
Erik

notes.title: Future Plans + Patch released!
notes.notes:
Hello Humans!

We just released a little Patch that fixes a wide variety of bugs and add a few improvements to the game. Read more about the details in the second half of this blog post!

[h1]What's next for Clone Drone??[/h1]

Since many of you are curious, let's talk about what are plans are for the future!

[h2]Adventure Levels[/h2]
In the immediate future, we're going to be focusing on expanding the capabilities of the Level Editor, creating a new type of level that takes place completely outside of the Arena!

Levels that quickly leave the arena to have a fantastic adventure elsewhere is a pretty common scenario among the more elaborate levels created by the community!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/7587852f9bb3f2f75c05aad19c2757b996c35ba7.png[/img]

We're really excited to see what everyone makes when this constraint is removed. We'll also be looking into things like checkpoints, saving progress etc. to let you make things that are similar in structure to our own Story Mode levels.

If this makes you at all excited, join us [url=https://www.twitch.tv/doborog]on Twitch[/url] where we'll be streaming the building of this feature! :)

[h2]Workshop Curation / Competitions![/h2]
The other side of our Level Editor focus is that we'll be looking into ways of supporting more official Level Editing Competitions, and find cool ways to highlight high quality workshop content that stands out from the crowd.

We really enjoy the energy of people coming together to make cool stuff, and want to set up systems that facilitate that happening on a regular basis. 

Next competition coming up will be for Halloween, but don't start making your levels yet. We'll likely make this one lean on our new format taking place outside of the Arena. :)

[h2]Server Stability / Performance[/h2]
In parallel to new feature development we are investigating ways to make our servers more performant and more reliable. This is a huge undertaking that involves overhauling how pretty much everything works in terms of hosting and matchmaking, so it might take a while, and comes with a healthy does of uncertainty in terms of specific outcomes.

Nevertheless this is something we feel could be better in the game right now, and we have some promising investigations in the works. More info about that when we have it!

[h2]Next game!??!?[/h2]
At some point in the next few months we'll start exploring what games we're making next! We'll still be working on some Clone Drone things at the same time, but if you see us start to work on weird things that have no robots or laser swords, this might be what's happening. ;)

[h2]New Multiplayer Game Modes[/h2]
It's maybe a bit early to talk about the specifics of this, but let's just say we are addicted to game modes and have plans to explore more of them!

What kind of game modes??? We'll likely experiment with more than one type to see what ends up being fun. Let us know what you'd be excited about in the comments!



[h1]Patch Notes![/h1]
ok, so that was a lot of info about the future. What did we do in the last few weeks? 
We made this patch that just went out! (1.0.0.24)

[h2]Emperor Combat Tweaks![/h2]
So right after launch you had a lot of feedback on the Emperor, especially on Insane difficulty!

For our immediate hotfix we didn't change the Emperor at all, but with this one we took the time to improve the fight in the following ways:
[list]
[*] Jump damage: No longer active at the start of the jump! No longer active directly after he lands.
[*] Shockwave attack: Decreased the radius slightly, and increased the cooldown before next use.
[*] Imperial Armor Bots: No longer give armor or shoot down arrows while they're being constructed!
[/list]
In addition to these changes, we also changed the amount of energy you have when mind transferred into robots! Both spear1 and sword1 now have 2 energy bars instead of 1, which makes confronting difficult enemies slightly less impossible with them. It also increases the tempo for both Chapter 4 and 5, so overall we think it's a pretty fun change!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/87aceff2b1e479be5a5e477eb8724089eab31196.gif[/img]

[h2]Performance improvements![/h2]
A focus for this release was to increase performance across the board. While many of these changes might be primarily felt in our console patches that also went out today, you might feel the improvements in the Steam version as well.

[h2]PlayStation / Switch: Full gyro support![/h2]
Do you enjoy having Gyro on all the time? We've added a setting to allow you to always turn your controller to turn the camera, as opposed to it only being active when using the bow.

[h2]Bug fixes![/h2]
[list]
[*] Music cutting out! We fixed the music sometimes cutting out when a lot of sounds were playing at once.
[*] Fixed a crash from your laser raptor friend lasering things in the central corridor of Chapter 5.
[*] The Emperor can now jump on jump pads without getting stuck
[*] Removed energy bar from end of chapter 3 cutscene.
[*] First Emperor confrontation in Chapter 5 now correctly resets your mind transfers.
[*] Chapter 5 Insane achievement: We had some reports of it not unlocking for people, and made the way we do that a bit more reliable.
[*] Fixed spectator mode not allowing you to switch character when using controller!
[*] Emperor skin had a bug where the legs would not fall off when cut in multiplayer. Fixed that!
[/list]

And there you have it! The next few months are going to be a lot of fun.
As always, let us know your thoughts in the comments!

Cheers,
Erik + team

Helloooo humans!

We just released a teeny update on Steam! It includes some important preparation for our full console release to support crossplay 🤫

We also want to share an update on our console review progress to hopefully help answer the question... “why is there no release date yet, foolish indie game developing humans?!?”

[h1]Upgrades to Support Crossplay[/h1]

Let's start with something invisible! This release includes an update to our networking library that will allow us to support crossplay on consoles. That means you will be able to play with your friends, even if they’re on a different platform (which is inferior to [i]your[/i] favorite gaming platform, of course 😛).

[h1]Some More Bug Fixes![/h1]

While the server already kicks AFK players from co-op games, it will now kick them even if other players are playing while ignoring them. This will occur after 30 minutes of no input in public game servers, so stay active if you want to keep your endless streak going!

In exciting Not Crashing News™... after months of investigation, we solved a multiplayer crash that sometimes happened after joining games! Thanks to everyone who sent in descriptions of their crash scenarios to our bugs email. These are super helpful for our bugfixing!

[h1]Chapter 5 & console porting release update[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/9fe4a39a0cb96c2e6486cb05004ffaa0fec272f0.gif[/img]

While we heard from other devs that simultaneous releases with crossplay support are tough, we didn’t expect quite how long it would take! Rest assured we’re doing everything we can to get the game fully released on all the consoles as soon as we can. For example, when new bugs come in from the console platform reviewers, we drop everything, fix them, and submit a new build immediately. While the console review process takes longer than our usual Steam release cycle, and it can be frustrating for us too, we hope crossplay with our console friends will be well worth it!

For anyone interested, here's what the console process looks like: we prepare a build, then the console platform QA team tests and finds any issues. We then fix them and submit another build. Then they find fewer, smaller issues, we fix them, and when they finally don’t find any more issues... we can set a release date!

Review rounds have taken longer on some consoles because of reduced QA capacity during COVID. Given this, it’s been extra hard to predict exactly how long we’ve had left. Since the discovered issues are becoming fewer and lower-impact, we’re hopeful we’ll be able to lock down and announce a release date soon. That said, there’s no way for us to know exactly how many issues remain for them to find... and how many more review cycles it will take! We're crossing our fingers, and we will keep you all updated!

That’s it for this teeny bugfix update! We have some other fun things planned before launch, too, if you want to follow along:

notes.title: Rules update: Teaming in public servers banned
notes.notes:
Hello humans,

--- [b]A quick summary of this post[/b] -----------------------------------------------

- [b]Teaming is not allowed[/b] on [i]any[/i] [u]public[/u] server (teaming on private servers is still fine!)

- From now on, possible consequences for teaming include: [b]temporary/permanent bans, win count resets[/b]

- [b]Reporting[/b] can be done via the in-game reporting, sending a Discord DM to Carissa or Josh, or emailing us at support@doborog.com. If you see it, let us know!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/7f79108548a3e2e9d32fa5e15e85057ec119ec85.png[/img]

There have been a lot of reports of teaming in public Last Bot Standing matches, and we have decided to officially say: [b]teaming is banned on [i]any[/i] public servers[/b]. Reminder that teaming in private servers is still allowed, as long as all players in the private server agree to it!

--- [b]What is teaming?[/b]-----------------------------------------------

Teaming is when two or more players join the same match, and agree to avoid targeting each other for any length of time (examples: the entire game, until the final area, until a certain number of players remain, etc.). Sometimes (but not always), players who are teaming will fight other players together. Teaming can happen to give these players upgrades and wins, and is unfair to everyone joining the game solo.

Any situation where players attempt to give a win to a specific person is considered teaming, regardless of how many players are involved or what public server they're on. It's against the rules to team in any public servers even if all players in that LBS match agree to team.

--- [b]Some examples of teaming[/b] -------
- Talking to other players--sometimes in-game (using emotes or other methods), or more often, outside the game (using voice chat, messages on Discord/Steam, etc.)--to create alliances or work together on some larger goal. (As a warning: going forward, using teaming as a method of combating someone else’s teaming may put you at risk. We do try to take into account players’s motivations when handing out consequences, but it is not always possible to do so 100% accurately)

--- [b]Some examples of [i][u]not[/u][/i] teaming[/b] -------
- Coincidentally all targeting the same person for a limited amount of time because they're the biggest threat (reasons for this include: they have the highest skill level, they have a really powerful upgrade (like giant mode), etc.)

- Running away from/not fighting someone because they're scary and you want to live lol


*Note that these examples are only a couple of common scenarios, and don’t include all possible scenarios.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We know it can be discouraging as a new player to see how skilled our veteran players are, and how high their wincounts are because of that. We’ve seen teaming used as a means of improving a new player’s experience. While we are still banning teaming in public servers, we see the need for more support for new players, and we’re currently doing some research into that. (As always, we strongly welcome community ideas and feedback!)

For our players who found the team gameplay aspect of teaming fun (especially our organized clans!), we’d love for you to reach out and let us know how we can support you in other ways. Things like organized private server teaming battles can be a lot of fun!
 
--- [b]Next steps[/b] -----------------------------------------------

There won't be any action taken against people who have used teaming before now because it wasn't an official rule. After this point however, we will begin investigating any teaming reports we receive. If, after investigation by our team, someone is determined to be teaming, consequences will be applied (including temporary/permanent bans and win count resets).

If you see anyone you suspect of teaming, please use the [b]in-game report system[/b] and reach out to us ([b]DM community managers Carissa or Josh via Discord, or email us at support@doborog.com[/b]).

Good luck in the arena,
Josh and Carissa
<3

notes.title: Update 19 - Spear & Shield Refresh, Japanese & Korean, Updated Next Chapter Date
notes.notes:
[i]Happy October[/i]! Doborog has been heads down hard at work on the epic final Story Mode chapter—see update on timing of that below—but we're taking a pit-stop to put out an update of some improvements we wanted to get out ASAP!

[h1]🛡 Spear and Shield Overhaul![/h1]

In response to feedback, we've decided to refresh the Spear and Shield mechanics! Many didn't like combat with the spear—to the point it was banned from fan tournaments due to flicking. We hope this update helps these weapons become a fun part of competitive play once again.

[list]
[*] [b]The Spear[/b] damage area (the part that destroys voxels) has been changed to wide instead of long, making the spear more effective when it travels forward, and worse when it travels sideways.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/7d78cd1cac76ee9908c931c2a698c64c8f5d4fa8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/9ad19153359a856adefada7aab69956b0c44c592.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Spear flicking[/b] was still possible in multiplayer, so we have restricted it even more. Let us know how it feels!
[*] [b]The Shield[/b] is now breakable! That's right. The shield no longer protects you forever, but takes damage whenever a weapon hits it. This makes combat more interesting, and opens up for strategies that are less about going around the shield, and more about whittling it down to get past it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/91ac2dc1dd715991b587f462318d47a9e8b0f564.gif[/img]

[/list]

[h1]🌏 Japanese (日本語) and Korean (한국어)![/h1]

Yes! More human languages for the communication bank. The robots now support Japanese and Korean subtitles.

Beautiful!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/327fc6299245b5c1288774ddcc1a631b097243d2.gif[/img]

Like with the other languages, we would love to hear your feedback to improve the quality of the translations. Let us know if something doesn't feel quite [i]qilsnib[/i] enough.

[h1]Quality of Life Improvements[/h1]

[h2]Better Crosshair for Spear and Bow[/h2]

The crosshair on the bow and spear could previously be hard to see depending on the situation. The bow and spear now have a new crosshair that's bigger and inverts the colors behind it for maximum contrast. Let us know how it feels!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/8080aa250c8dcd44d9b8aacdca3418053c36e9d0.gif[/img]

[h2]Arrow Rotation now SNAPS[/h2]
Arrow rotation now snaps instantly between vertical and horizontal mode, giving you unprecedented tactical control for how you deal damage. Hotshot Arrow-Shooting Tip: Spidertrons mainly bob up and down.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28064438/1c6e61ee9b4b551ca8c878a9bc28bcb298865fc7.gif[/img]

[h2]Head Damage: Not always fatal![/h2]

Has THIS ever happened to YOU: 3 decorative voxels get taken off the beautiful horn attachment of your robot head, and you fall down on the ground, dead as the day you were harvested?

Now head damage is only fatal if it damages the important cubes sitting near where your central processing unit resides (a 2x2 cube 3 voxels above the neck).

[h2]Helping Stationary Bow1s Un-stick in Twitch Mode[/h2]

In Twitch Mode bow1s now walk towards you if they're the last type of enemy in the level, which should cause fewer issues with them landing on pillars and taunting your inability to destroy them.

[h2]Fix for Armor Exploit in Last Bot Standing[/h2]

It used to be possible to acquire armor in LBS, leave and re-join the match, and continue to have that armor for zero upgrade points. No longer!

[h1]Chapter 5 - New Release Date[/h1]

We are still hard at work on Chapter 5, and we're now aiming to release it early next year.

Why the delay? A few reasons combined made it a choice we hope you can appreciate:

[list]
[*] [b]Scope/Quality/Time balance[/b] - As some say, pick two 😅.  While we could have rushed the final chapter update out sooner, we felt that adding a bit of time lets us get closer to the updates the game deserves for its exit out of Early Access. This includes the quality of life changes in this update, and epic-ness of Chapter 5 :)
[*] [b]Making a big splash with full release[/b] - We are planning a big push to share the game more widely with the full release, and (you might have noticed) the end of this year is packed with the releases of new games and consoles. We want to harvest and upload the minds of as many humans as possible into the arena at release, and we've learned choosing the date wisely is part of that. We will announce more about the release here at a later time, too!
[*] [b]Console requirements[/b] - We are planning to launch on (at least) 3 different consoles! Parallel to Chapter 5, our porting team has been working tirelessly towards making sure the game has the features required by consoles.
[/list]

As always, for those of you who live on the bleeding edge, you can [url=https://www.twitch.tv/doborog]follow our development live on Twitch[/url], and even try out the current (very buggy!) build in the experimental branch. While we know how it can be disappointing to have release dates slip, we hope you all can appreciate where we’re landing!

Thank you all for being amazing OG Clone Drone community members! We are so glad to have those of you who have stuck with us throughout the long development process with us during launch and beyond. 💙

notes.title: Multiplayer Development Progress Update & 1v1 Features!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/55ee9232515d7fe157473fedf57e6680a5011310.gif[/img]

Ahoy friends! We're super hard at work on Multiplayer Duel Mode, but wanted to take a quick second to update everyone on our progress!

[b]tl;dr: We're making good progress! We're shooting to officially launch 1v1 in April (later than we'd hoped!), but in the mean-time you can follow along with [url=https://twitch.tv/doborog]Erik's live dev streams[/url] and try our [url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/multiplayer-test-builds/]bleeding-edge development test version[/url]![/b]

[h1]What's Done![/h1]
[h1]The Duel Match Structure[/h1]
We're zeroing in on a final, fun match structure for duels. Each player starts the match with 3 lives, and after deaths, players get to pick an upgrade!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/856c36d70831a073d0cdc9918b3a7099fef0d45b.png[/img]

Picking upgrades after death adds another layer of strategy to the game, letting you react to your opponent's choices and the map you're on!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/75510cc683a5b4320b2cacb73943a6601e60c6d3.gif[/img]

[h1]Multiplayer-ifying Upgrades, Weapons, and Hazards![/h1]
As part of making the game work for multiplayer, we've been converting everything over to be multiplayer-compatible, including nearly every upgrade (hammer, bow, jetpack, kick) and hazards (sawblades, spikes, moving platforms over dangerous lava). While you may have kicked a Sword 1 robot or two into sawblades before, we're finding it's a totally fresh experience sending real human-controlled robots to their doom. Practice your maniacal laugh, you'll need it.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/b15c79762f56f9bbe72396e4de734b62f10850f6.gif[/img]

[h1]Dedicated Servers![/h1]
When we built Long Live Santa! as a test game, we used a direct peer-to-peer connection for matches. While this worked okay (and cost a good bit less) -- players who were acting as the host would sometimes drop, some hosts would have inconsistent internet connections or high pings to others in matches, and in some cases use their position as server host as an unfair advantage!

For Clone Drone's multiplayer, we're pulling out all the stops and hosting our own full-on auto-scaling dedicated servers! While the development branch is currently targeting a single region (US-East), soon we will support servers in regions worldwide, so not only should gameplay be nice & fair, but hopefully pings will be buttery-low!
[h1]What's Left to Do![/h1]
While we'd love to launch right now, we've got some things to do before shipping multiplayer to everyone!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/687e0ebe1e7ab159df81c9713c32d23764afe41d.png[/img]

[list]
 	[*]Add some awesome multiplayer arena levels! While we have a few early level ideas, there's a lot of potential for fun new combat levels. Some will even take place outside of the classic arena![/*]
 	[*]Make all of single player work again! In the process of multiplayer-ifying everything, there are some things in single-player that need a bit of updating to work right again. On the bright side, this will make adding co-op much quicker once we get to that :)[/*]
 	[*]Stability, anti-cheat security, performance, etc! We want to make this release as solid as possible, and lots of things have changed![/*]
[/list]
The up-shot of all this is -- once we've developed this core fighting experience, other game modes will become easier and quicker to add! We're super excited about what's next for multiplayer (and [url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/2018/01/28/multiplayer-1v1-is-coming/]shared some of our ideas in this other post[/url]), and can't wait to start slicing you all in half with our laser swords.
[h1]Follow Along and Let's Do This![/h1]
[list]
 	[*][url=https://www.twitch.tv/doborog]Come watch Erik develop the game on Twitch[/url]! Say hello and some words of encouragement!! :)[/*]
 	[*][url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/multiplayer-test-builds/]Try the multiplayer development branch[/url] (warning: quite buggy, and not many players on it yet!). We update it many times per day with our latest development progress.
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/c4bb71dfab3671b195877b4b3628fb6800e4cf33.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28064438/fcdc74cca6da9f22ff7165bf14fcc772b7597a8f.png[/img]

We're getting there! Thanks for everyone who has been testing out builds and following along our development!! We can do this!!! [b]YEAHH!!!![/b]

notes.title: 0.9.1 – The Twitchy Update: Suggest Workshop Levels, Big Stream Support, and Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Panic-Gif.gif[/img]

Surprise, it's a mini-update!

While Doborog starts in on building Story Mode Chapter 3 (and [url=https://twitter.com/bcjordan/status/878634908314456064]begins teaching his own clone how to do things[/url]), we couldn't help but release our latest batch of Twitch improvements ASAP!
[h1]Share Your Workshop Levels With !suggest[/h1]
Sharing your sweet workshop levels with Twitch streamers used to be a pain -- you had to:
[list]
 	[*]Send your streamer a link (which would usually get auto-deleted...)[/*]
 	[*]Convince them to open a browser and subscribe to it.[/*]
 	[*]Hope and pray your level would eventually show up in the random Twitch rotation.[/*]
[/list]
Not good enough!!

Now you can send levels directly to your favorite Twitch streamer! Just type:

[b]!suggest [workshop ID][/b]

and streamers will instantly see:

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/queue-vote.gif[/img]

When accepted, levels will auto-download and become the next level in the rotation. Neat!

To get your workshop level's ID, go to its workshop page and grab the number from the id= part of the URL:

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/2017-07-13-21_59_26-Steam-Workshop-__-Hellgate-Endless-mode.png[/img]

So go to your favorite [url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Clone Drone in the Danger Zone]Clone Drone Twitch stream[/url] and send em a level to try [url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/workshop-endless]from the Workshop[/url]!
[h1]Level Editor: Twitch Spawn Areas and a Raptor Statue![/h1]
Tired of Twitch enemies spawning to their deaths or to un-reachable locations on your levels? Now you can configure Twitch spawn areas, so all Twitch enemy spawns on your level will target the areas you set!

[b]What you do[/b]: Just drag a few of these areas out, and Twitch enemies will spawn there!

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Spawn-Areas.gif[/img]

[b]Pro tip[/b]: the vertical position of the spawn area is ignored, and spawn positions are found from top-down, so you can put these hints floating above the level if it's more convenient to lay them out like that.

[b]How it works on Twitch[/b]: when spawning an enemy, the game will randomly select one of the spawn areas you've laid out, and then randomly select a position within that.
[h1]"Remember Me" for Twitch Logins[/h1]
There's now a handy checkbox to save your Twitch username/auth token! No more fumbling around with your browser and clipboard when trying to connect live on stream.[url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Save-Login.png]
[/url]

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Remember-Me.png[/img]
[h1]Twitch "Up Next" and "Spawning Allowed" Notifications[/h1]
Twitch mode will now tell the audience what level is up next (and if it's from the workshop, a link to the level), and when it's OK to start spawning. Especially on big streams, it used to be hard to know exactly when to begin !spawning to get in before the limit gets hit.

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Spawn-Now.png[/img]

We've included a built-in delay roughly matching the stream delay so it doesn't spoil the outcome of the round you're watching.

Happy [b]!spawn[/b]ing!

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Spawned-Enemy-1024x695.png[/img]
[h1]Big Stream Throttling & High Traffic Mode[/h1]
Before this update, Twitch Mode on gigantic streams would usually result in streamers being temporarily global-banned from Twitch chat due to high # of messages the bot would send in a short period of time. 😅

With 0.9.1, Twitch mode will queue and throttle messages to keep you under the 80-message-per-30-seconds-in-your-own-channel limit, and when things get busy, enter a [b]high-traffic mode[/b], where:
[list]
 	[*][b]!coins[/b] reports get collated and sent in batched reports.[/*]
 	[*]"Too many enemies have been spawned" messages show up just once per round.[/*]
[/list]
[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Lots-of-Emotes-1024x638.png[/img]

[u]If you've got a really big stream and still see issues, email us support@doborog.com and we'll figure out how to tweak it to make it work for you! (And if you'd like to be added to our streaming press list for updates as well, let us know!)[/u]
[h1]Bug Fixes![/h1]
C'mon, you know we can't help smashing at least a few bugs!

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Spidertron-Bug-Smash-1024x513.png[/img]
[list]
 	[*]Twitch Mode now shows "Now Playing" TVs and UIs, so you can tell which workshop items you're playing.
[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/TV-Showing-1024x703.png[/img][/*]
 	[*]Fixed a bug where endless workshop levels with multiple difficulties would always select the first difficulty, which resulted in hard levels in easier tiers![/*]
 	[*]"Workshop and Normal Levels" now alternate between workshop and non-workshop levels when they have been played the same # of times, instead of just playing a single workshop level and then only normal levels.[/*]
 	[*]The default endless workshop policy is now "Workshop and Normal Levels" instead of "Workshop only"[/*]
 	[*]Level editor: make zooming in exponential, so you can zoom in to see much smaller things.
[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/zoom-in.gif[/img][/*]
 	[*]Fix rare crash that would occur when unsubscribing from currently played workshop level while in Twitch mode.[/*]
 	[*]If levels on the workshop have no enemies, the game will now skip the level & send us a report so we can investigate and remove them from the workshop.[/*]
[/list]

Go check out some [url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Clone Drone in the Danger Zone]Twitch streams[/url] streams, find some cool [url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/workshop-endless]levels in the workshop[/url] and suggest them! And watch for our next post with details on Story Mode Chapter 3, coming late August!

When accepted, levels will auto-download and become the next level in the rotation. Neat!

To get your workshop level's ID, go to its workshop page and grab the number from the id= part of the URL:

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/2017-07-13-21_59_26-Steam-Workshop-__-Hellgate-Endless-mode.png[/img]

So go to your favorite [url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Clone Drone in the Danger Zone]Clone Drone Twitch stream[/url] and send em a level to try [url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/workshop-endless]from the Workshop[/url]!
[h1]Level Editor: Twitch Spawn Areas and a Raptor Statue![/h1]
Tired of Twitch enemies spawning to their deaths or to un-reachable locations on your levels? Now you can configure Twitch spawn areas, so all Twitch enemy spawns on your level will target the areas you set!

[b]What you do[/b]: Just drag a few of these areas out, and Twitch enemies will spawn there!

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Spawn-Areas.gif[/img]

[b]Pro tip[/b]: the vertical position of the spawn area is ignored, and spawn positions are found from top-down, so you can put these hints floating above the level if it's more convenient to lay them out like that.

[b]How it works on Twitch[/b]: when spawning an enemy, the game will randomly select one of the spawn areas you've laid out, and then randomly select a position within that.
[h1]"Remember Me" for Twitch Logins[/h1]
There's now a handy checkbox to save your Twitch username/auth token! No more fumbling around with your browser and clipboard when trying to connect live on stream.[url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Save-Login.png]
[/url]

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Remember-Me.png[/img]
[h1]Twitch "Up Next" and "Spawning Allowed" Notifications[/h1]
Twitch mode will now tell the audience what level is up next (and if it's from the workshop, a link to the level), and when it's OK to start spawning. Especially on big streams, it used to be hard to know exactly when to begin !spawning to get in before the limit gets hit.

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Spawn-Now.png[/img]

We've included a built-in delay roughly matching the stream delay so it doesn't spoil the outcome of the round you're watching.

Happy [b]!spawn[/b]ing!

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Spawned-Enemy-1024x695.png[/img]
[h1]Big Stream Throttling & High Traffic Mode[/h1]
Before this update, Twitch Mode on gigantic streams would usually result in streamers being temporarily global-banned from Twitch chat due to high # of messages the bot would send in a short period of time. 😅

With 0.9.1, Twitch mode will queue and throttle messages to keep you under the 80-message-per-30-seconds-in-your-own-channel limit, and when things get busy, enter a [b]high-traffic mode[/b], where:
[list]
 	[*][b]!coins[/b] reports get collated and sent in batched reports.[/*]
 	[*]"Too many enemies have been spawned" messages show up just once per round.[/*]
[/list]
[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Lots-of-Emotes-1024x638.png[/img]

[u]If you've got a really big stream and still see issues, email us support@doborog.com and we'll figure out how to tweak it to make it work for you! (And if you'd like to be added to our streaming press list for updates as well, let us know!)[/u]
[h1]Bug Fixes![/h1]
C'mon, you know we can't help smashing at least a few bugs!

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Spidertron-Bug-Smash-1024x513.png[/img]
[list]
 	[*]Twitch Mode now shows "Now Playing" TVs and UIs, so you can tell which workshop items you're playing.
[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/TV-Showing-1024x703.png[/img][/*]
 	[*]Fixed a bug where endless workshop levels with multiple difficulties would always select the first difficulty, which resulted in hard levels in easier tiers![/*]
 	[*]"Workshop and Normal Levels" now alternate between workshop and non-workshop levels when they have been played the same # of times, instead of just playing a single workshop level and then only normal levels.[/*]
 	[*]The default endless workshop policy is now "Workshop and Normal Levels" instead of "Workshop only"[/*]
 	[*]Level editor: make zooming in exponential, so you can zoom in to see much smaller things.
[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/zoom-in.gif[/img][/*]
 	[*]Fix rare crash that would occur when unsubscribing from currently played workshop level while in Twitch mode.[/*]
 	[*]If levels on the workshop have no enemies, the game will now skip the level & send us a report so we can investigate and remove them from the workshop.[/*]
[/list]

Go check out some [url=https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Clone Drone in the Danger Zone]Twitch streams[/url] streams, find some cool [url=http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/workshop-endless]levels in the workshop[/url] and suggest them! And watch for our next post with details on Story Mode Chapter 3, coming late August!

notes.notes:
[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/what.gif[/img]

An unannounced update?? Wha-a-a-a-t?

We decided to put out an update with some of the smaller bits and bobs we've been fixing since 0.8.1 so you can enjoy them NOW!

This update includes: [b]Level Editor Improvements[/b], [b]Bug Fixes[/b], and [b]"Now Playing" [/b]interfaces!

[h1]Custom Colors![/h1]
Now you can re-style any re-skinnable level item with the new Custom Color picker!

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/picker.gif[/img]

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/2017-06-08-23_26_15-.eJwNyEsOhCAMANC7cAA-LS3gZQxBgiYqRDqrydx93LzF-6rPc6pF7SJjLsZsxyz92fSU_uRWdeu9nTW.png[/img]

[h1]The Corner Wedge[/h1]

Unassuming yet powerful, the Corner Wedge is perfect for smoothing out the sharp edges of level elements.

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/lonely-wedge.png[/img]

Resize it, and it still looks good. Wow!

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/corner-wedge.png[/img]
And it comes in 10 sleek styles!

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/wedge-styles.png[/img]

[h1]The Light Pillar[/h1]

It's light, in that it is lighter than the dark pillar. And it emits light.

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/light-pillars-1024x508.png[/img]

Pretty!

[h1]Bug Smashing[/h1]

We smashed a bunch of bugs!

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/spidertron-smash.gif[/img]

[list]
 	[*]Head kills now require 3 or more head voxels to be damaged. Shave carefully![/*]
 	[*]Arrows you JUST deflected should not hit your body after deflection -- and, conversely, arrows that already hit you should not be deflected). Your death should feel normal! (We're still hunting down one more edge case of this, but should happen way less often. Holler if you see it!)

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/arrow-lol-1024x597.png[/img]

 	[*]Player movement while on overlapping moving platforms should work better![/*]
 	[*]Swinging [u]forwards[/u] with block arrows should now always block arrows in front of you.[/*]
 	[*]Free Clones at the beginning of the first plays of challenges should now be properly gifted! <3 <3 <3[/*]
 	[*]Author names for workshop items should now consistently show up.[/*]
 	[*]The Level Editor Inspector now SCROLLS! So you can now have a ton of trigger zones and be able to use them when configuring moving platforms.[/*]
 	[*]Mousewheel scrolling the level editor zoom is faster![/*]
 	[*]Mousewheel scrolling for the Level Editor Library now works and feels good! And doesn't zoom the level in and out![/*]
 	[*]Ctrl + D to duplicate does not pan the level editor to the left anymore.[/*]
 	[*]Restarting an endless playtest when you have upgrade points will now re-spawn you in the upgrade room (so you can use your points!)[/*]
 	[*]You can now type decimal numbers 0.___ in the Level Editor's Scale fields without it annoyingly putting 0.01 when you type 0.[/*]
 	[*]Have a ton of levels? The level list for the challenge creation screen now has a scroll bar![/*]
[/list]
Find a new bug or the recurrence of one we thought we fixed?! Upset we didn't fix the one that is bugging YOU? [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/597170/discussions/0/133260909499856654/#c133260909499869727]Send it along to us![/url] We'll make sure it's in our bug tracker, prioritized relative to everything else we want to add to / improve in the game, and Erik and I may even get around to SMASHING IT!
[h1]Now Playing[/h1]
It used to be impossible to tell what workshop endless level you were playing, let alone rate or unsubscribe from them quickly.

Now you can just check the TV:

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/now-playing-tvs-1024x487.png[/img]

Open the Escape Menu...

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/esc-now-playing.png[/img]

Beat the challenge:

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/2017-06-08-23_49_11-Unity-Personal-64bit-Gameplay.unity-voxelmech-PC-Mac-Linux-Standalone.png[/img]

Or just wait for the insta-voter to slide out after you beat the level! (Vote quickly using your keyboard!)

[img]http://clonedroneinthedangerzone.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/RateLastLEvel.gif[/img]

So efficient!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/597170/workshop/]Subscribe to a bunch of endless levels and challenges[/url] to try it all out, and share your opinion on workshop levels!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/597170/workshop/]http://steamcommunity.com/app/597170/workshop/[/url]
[h1]What's next??[/h1]
We wanted to get this mini-update out ASAP so you can start playing with it all now, but this is not all we've been working on. [b]The next major update launches on June 25.[/b]

And we're posting a preview of it... very soon! Watch out for it!
